'''Brethupp''' was an [[Ewok]] who lived in [[Bright Tree Village]] on the [[Endor|forest moon]] of [[Endor]]. In [[4 ABY]], Brethupp was present in the village center when a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|rebel]] captives were brought in by a [[scout]]ing party. The Ewok initially moved toward the [[prisoner]] [[Han Solo]] as the captives were being prepared as part of a banquet in honor of the [[protocol droid]] [[C-3PO]], who the Ewoks thought was a [[deity]], but after the prisoner [[Luke Skywalker]] [[Telekinesis|lifted]] the [[droid]] into the air using [[the Force]], Brethupp rushed to free the captives on the orders of the [[shaman]] [[Logray]].

The Ewoks soon chose to aid the rebels in their [[Battle of Endor|fight]] against the [[Galactic Empire]] on Endor and fought alongside them the following [[Standard day|day]]. After the alliance defeated the Imperials, festivities were held in the village during which Brethupp [[drum]]med on a series of Imperial [[helmet]]s collected as trophies.

==Biography==
Brethupp<ref name="Funko">{{WebCite|url=https://funkoeurope.com/products/brethupp-star-wars-return-of-the-jedi|text=Brethupp - Star Wars: Return of the Jedi|archivedate=20230727102805}}</ref> was an [[Ewok]] member of the [[Bright Tree tribe]] that dwelt in [[Bright Tree Village]] on the [[forest]] [[moon]] of [[Endor]]. In [[4 ABY]], Brethupp was present in the village center when a [[scout]]ing group led by the Ewok [[Teebo]] returned to the village after having captured a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|rebel offworlders]] who had been caught in an Ewok net trap. Bound below wooden poles, the captives were set down in the village, with the [[smuggler]] [[Han Solo]] positioned above an unlit fire pit. Brethupp rushed to tend to the pit beneath Solo as [[C-3PO]], a [[protocol droid]] ally of the captives that the Ewoks had mistaken for the [[deity]] known as the [[Golden One]], was seated on a throne in the square.<ref name="Episode VI" />

As C-3PO conversed with the tribe's [[shaman]], Brethupp moved through a group of Ewoks who had gathered in front of the droid while carrying a [[spear]]. After the [[droid]] failed to convince the Ewoks not to cook his friends as part of a banquet in his honor, the [[Jedi]] [[Luke Skywalker]], who was among the captives, used [[the Force]] to [[Telekinesis|lift]] C-3PO and his throne into the air above the gathered Ewoks. Terrified, the panicked Ewoks fled away from the center, with Brethupp running toward [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]], a guest of the village and ally of the captives, and then standing next to the captive [[astromech droid]] [[R2-D2]]. Logray quickly commmanded that the prisoners be released, and Brethupp was part of the group that surged forward to free them.<ref name="Episode VI" />

[[File:Brethupp_drumming.png|thumb|right|300px|Brethupp drummed on Imperial helmets after the Battle of Endor.]]
The rebels were soon accepted into the tribe, and [[Chief]] [[Chirpa]] declared that they would aid the rebels in [[Battle of Endor|attacking]] a [[Endor shield generator bunker|shield generator bunker]] that the [[Galactic Empire]] had established on the moon. The next day, the Ewoks and rebels succeeded in destroying the bunker, which allowed an [[Rebel Alliance Navy|Alliance fleet]] to in turn destroy the [[DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station|second Death Star]], an Imperial [[battle station]] orbiting the moon. That night, the Ewoks celebrated with their new rebel allies in the village. During the festivities,<ref name="Episode VI" /> Brethupp drummed on a trophy collection of Imperial [[helmet]]s.<ref name="AD">{{Film|VI}} {{AD|Disney+}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
Brethupp had mottled [[Color|gray]] and white [[Hair|fur]].<ref name="Episode VI" />

==Equipment==
Brethupp wore a black [[Clothing|hood]] and a brown [[belt]]. The Ewok carried a spear while in the village and used drumsticks while playing the makeshift drum set during the celebration.<ref name="Episode VI" />

==Behind the scences==
[[File:Kiran_Shah_with_Brethupp_costume.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Brethupp was portrayed by Kiran Shah.]]
Brethupp was portrayed by [[Kiran Shah]]<ref name="CNN">{{WebCite|url=https://www.cnn.com/style/article/kiran-shah-profile-spc-intl/index.html|text=Kiran Shah: The hero with a thousand faces|work=CNN Style|archivedate=20220909052738}}</ref> in the [[1983]] [[original trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']].<ref name="Episode VI" /> The Ewok village scenes were filmed between [[January 18]] and [[February 2]], [[1982]] on Stage 3 at [[Elstree Studios]].<ref name="MakingOf">''[[The Making of Star Wars: Return of the Jedi]]''</ref>

In the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], the character was identified on a [[Wikipedia:Funko|Funko Pop!]] figure released for the 40th anniversary of ''Return of the Jedi'' in [[2023]]. The Funko figure had a brown hood rather than the black hood seen in the film.<ref name="Funko" /> The [[Brethupp|character's]] name originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where the Ewok was first identified in the article ''Ewoks: Warriors of Endor'' in the [[Rogues Gallery (department)|''Rogues Gallery'']] department of ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' [[Star Wars Insider 135|135]],<ref name="Rogues">{{InsiderCite|135|Rogues Gallery|Rogues Gallery: The Ewoks: Warriors of Endor!}}</ref> which was written by [[Leland Chee]] and published on [[July 24]], [[2012]].<ref name="Date">[[Star Wars Insider 134|''Star Wars Insider'' 134]]</ref>
